name: Adaptive Time-step Training Framework
aliases: Adaptive Time-step Training for Spike-Based Neural Radiance Fields
definition: A two-stage training framework that learns a scene-wise temporal budget and applies a shared target time step to all sampling points within a scene, preserving parallel inference while adapting computation to scene complexity.
summary: Adaptive Time-step Training Framework is a spike-based NeRF strategy that learns a scene-wise temporal budget to reduce inference steps while preserving parallel rendering patterns.
